import pandas as pd

DATA_PATH = 'data/dataset.csv'  # Correcting the path to the dataset
df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)
df.head()

# Display the columns of the DataFrame to understand its structure better
df.columns.tolist()

# Preprocess the data to create a transaction list for Market Basket Analysis
# Group by transaction_id and aggregate product_category based on units_sold
transaction_list = df.groupby('transaction_id').apply(
    lambda x: list(x['product_category'].repeat(x['units_sold']))
).reset_index(name='items')

# Display the first few transactions to verify the preprocessing
transaction_list.head()

# Importing the necessary libraries for Market Basket Analysis
from mlxtend.frequent_patterns import apriori, association_rules
from mlxtend.preprocessing import TransactionEncoder

# Transform the transaction list into a format suitable for the Apriori algorithm
te = TransactionEncoder()
te_ary = te.fit(transaction_list['items']).transform(transaction_list['items'])
df_items = pd.DataFrame(te_ary, columns=te.columns_)

# Apply the Apriori algorithm to find frequent itemsets with a minimum support of 0.01
frequent_itemsets = apriori(df_items, min_support=0.01, use_colnames=True)

# Display the first few frequent itemsets
frequent_itemsets.head()

# Derive association rules from the frequent itemsets
rules = association_rules(frequent_itemsets, metric="confidence", min_threshold=0.1)

# Calculate lift for the rules
rules['lift'] = rules['confidence'] / rules['support']

# Display the first few association rules
rules.head()

# Display the frequent itemsets to analyze their support values
frequent_itemsets.sort_values(by='support', ascending=False)  # Sorting by support to analyze
